behavior.arguments: rsi = base pointer; the compared double is *(rsi+0xf38) (a pointer-sized field load, then a double load through it); no other argument is read
behavior.branch_order: no branches inside the window; one comisd followed by one setae, then ret
behavior.low_byte_rule: (rax & 0xff) == 1 iff *(rsi+0xf38) >= 1.0 (IEEE 754 double comparison via comisd/setae; NaN is unordered so setae is false), else 0; upper bytes of rax are NOT determined by this window because no instruction zeroes eax before the setae
behavior.output_shape: rax low byte is the gate bit, then ret
behavior.unsigned_note: comisd/setae is an ordered floating-point comparison, not an unsigned integer comparison; NaN yields 0

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase
